Card Q&A.a: Yes, all of those Digimon are prevented from leaving. This card's [All Turns] effect affects all Digimon without having to choose them.
Card Q&A.q: If I activate this card's [All Turns] effect when multiples of my [Bagra Army] trait Digimon would leave the battle area at the same time by effects, are all of those Digimon prevented from leaving?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed. The conditions for this [All Turns] effect require you to trash the specified number of digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: Can I trash just 1 digivolution card for the conditions of this card's [All Turns] effect?
If I choose this card itself for its [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect, can I activate its [All Turns] effect when my opponent's Digimon and this card itself would be deleted?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may choose 1 of your Digimon. Delete the chosen Digimon and 1 of your opponent’s Digimon with as high or lower a level as it.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your [Bagra Army] trait Digimon would leave the battle area by effects, by trashing any 2 of this Digimon's digivolution cards, they don't leave.
Special Play Condition: DigiXros -2: 2 Digimon cards w/[Bagra Army] trait
When this would be played, you may place specified cards from your hand/battle area under it. Each one reduces the play cost.
